title: Monthly Client Report Pack
description: Merge the month's reports and insights for one client into a client-ready pack: executive summary, per-channel results, learnings, and next month's plan.

nodes.title: Gather the month's reports and insights
nodes.detail: Read files in reports_dir and data/insights matching month_label (weekly performance reports, hashtag trackers, follower snapshots, trend briefs). Summarize per channel (IG / Threads / YouTube / other): key metrics (follower change, total reach and engagement, posts published), the month's top 3 winning posts, and 1–2 underperformers. Mark channels with no data explicitly as 'no data'.
nodes.acceptance: Every channel with data is summarized; missing channels are listed explicitly.

subtasks.title: Scan and load the month's files
subtasks.purpose: Full inventory of this month's outputs

subtasks.title: Summarize metrics per channel
subtasks.purpose: Change, reach, engagement rolled up per channel

outputScope.name: missing_channels
outputScope.description: Channels with no data this month

nodes.title: Verify roll-up coverage
nodes.detail: Check that channel_summaries has at least one entry, each summary contains metrics and winning posts, files_read is not empty, and missing-channel labeling is consistent.

nodes.title: Generate the client report pack
nodes.detail: Generate the pack with: (1) a one-page executive summary — three-line takeaway and the headline numbers, in client-friendly language, (2) per-channel sections — metric tables, winning content and why it worked, misses and lessons, (3) what we learned — validated hooks, formats, and posting times, (4) next month's plan — five prioritized actions with owner channels. Tables and text only, no images. Write for the client, not the team: plain language, no internal jargon.
nodes.acceptance: All four parts complete and written in client-facing language.

subtasks.title: Write the executive summary
subtasks.purpose: Three-line conclusion a busy client reads first

subtasks.title: Build per-channel sections
subtasks.purpose: Tables, winners, and lessons per channel

subtasks.title: Draft next month's plan
subtasks.purpose: Turn learnings into five prioritized actions
